verdict.rationale: Jira's own materials say it connects to the Atlassian Marketplace with over 3,000 integrations, naming apps such as Tempo Timesheets and Zephyr, which directly matches the 'thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace' story. The evidence is marketing-level feature-page claims only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on discovering and installing marketplace apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Choose from the over 3000+ integrations available in the Atlassian Marketplace.
Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr, and over 3,000 other apps ensure Jira Software can be custom tailored to fit any and every use case.
